statement: ∀ (a : ℝ), 0 ≤ a → (StrictMono fun x => x ^ 3 + a * x) ∧ Function.Injective fun x => x ^ 3 + a * x
script:
# name: set-cubic-strictmono-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Injective.cubic_strictMono
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['1', '(by norm_num)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a), StrictMono (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3 + a * x) ∧ Function.Injective (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3 + a * x) := by
  intro a ha
  have h : StrictMono (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3 + a * x) := by
    intro x y hxy
    simp only
    have h1 : 0 < y - x := sub_pos.2 hxy
    have h2 : 0 < y ^ 2 + x * y + x ^ 2 + a := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x + y), mul_pos h1 h1]
    nlinarith [mul_pos h1 h2]
  exact ⟨h, h.injective⟩
exact @key (1) ((by norm_num))'),
    (['0', '(by norm_num)'], True, 'have key : ∀ (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a), StrictMono (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3 + a * x) ∧ Function.Injective (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3 + a * x) := by
  intro a ha
  have h : StrictMono (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3 + a * x) := by
    intro x y hxy
    simp only
    have h1 : 0 < y - x := sub_pos.2 hxy
    have h2 : 0 < y ^ 2 + x * y + x ^ 2 + a := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x + y), mul_pos h1 h1]
    nlinarith [mul_pos h1 h2]
  exact ⟨h, h.injective⟩
exact @key (0) ((by norm_num))'),
    (['2', '(by norm_num)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a), StrictMono (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3 + a * x) ∧ Function.Injective (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3 + a * x) := by
  intro a ha
  have h : StrictMono (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3 + a * x) := by
    intro x y hxy
    simp only
    have h1 : 0 < y - x := sub_pos.2 hxy
    have h2 : 0 < y ^ 2 + x * y + x ^ 2 + a := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x + y), mul_pos h1 h1]
    nlinarith [mul_pos h1 h2]
  exact ⟨h, h.injective⟩
exact @key (2) ((by norm_num))'),
]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=proof, edge=edge) for values, edge, proof in CASES]

goal.text: (StrictMono fun x => x ^ 3 + a * x) ∧ Function.Injective fun x => x ^ 3 + a * x
